title: Notification Routing Rules
isAsyncHint: Async = the request enqueues and returns immediately, the queue writes the conclusion back to the ledger; Sync = it dials in-request and the response IS the delivery result
isEnabledHint: Disabling makes this route inactive: callers of that event get a "no enabled routing rule" error instead of a silently dropped notification
deleteConfirm: After deletion this event stops notifying and the row is not re-seeded on restart. Delete?
testDispatchHint: Runs the whole delivery chain for this rule once: routing, channel and ledger all behave as in production, so you see what a real dispatch would do
testTargetHint: Webhook falls back to the callback URL on the channel config when left blank; email requires a value
testDispatchSent: Dispatched, ledger #{id} — open the delivery records page and look it up by this ID
testDispatchQueued: Handed to the queue, ledger #{id} — this rule is async, the conclusion lands in the delivery records shortly
